verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs describe AI auto-coding: transactions are categorized from transaction details, history and team feedback, then synced coded to the ERP. Invoices are coded to the right GL account, and an AI agent handles auto-coding. Multi-entity support is documented, but only as a separate feature, never as entity-aware auto-coding, so the cross-entity part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that auto-coding applies per entity or across entities, documentation of how close is accelerated (e.g., close metrics or a close workflow), and independent or hands-on corroboration of coding accuracy.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI automatically assign GL codes to transactions across entities to accelerate close

citations.quote: Ramp automatically categorizes transactions based on transaction details, historical information, and your team's direct feedback, then syncs coded transactions directly to your ERP.
